build_pad_tensor_n: build a function that pads a list of 1D tensors to a uniform max length along the first axis
create_stack_tensor_dict_list: create a function that stacks a list of tensor dictionaries into a single dictionary of stacked tensors
test_split_tensor_dict_list: test splitting a stacked tensor dictionary back into a list of per-sample dictionaries
refactor_concat_tensor_list_subsample: refactor the tensor list concatenation with subsampling to support configurable random seeds
summarize_flatten_unflatten_tensors: summarize the flatten and unflatten tensor pair for converting between flat and structured tensor representations
